Next Monday's planned enablement is blocked. A new enablement date will be set only after (1) the specific contractual advance notice period for the 2 named tenants is confirmed in writing and (2) sufficient time has passed to satisfy that notice obligation.
Payload retention remains at 30 days in the policy. The 2 named enterprise tenants contractually require 7-day replay availability, which is satisfied by the 30-day retention period.
